package.title: UX: Frontend Performance & Asset Modernization
package.summary: The frontend ships CoffeeScript (deprecated, removed from Rails 7 defaults), Turbolinks (replaced by Hotwire/Turbo in 2021), jQuery as a global (90KB), three jQuery plugins (flexslider, colorbox, owl.carousel), and render-blocking Google Fonts. All project screenshots are PNG (no WebP). This package cuts the JS payload, removes deprecated tech, and modernizes the asset pipeline.

findings.title: CoffeeScript is deprecated and removed from Rails 7 defaults
Turbolinks is deprecated - replaced by Hotwire/Turbo in 2021
jQuery loaded as a global - 90KB+ for what could be 0KB of vanilla JS
Google Fonts loaded render-blocking without preconnect
All project screenshots are PNG (no WebP/AVIF) - 30-50% larger
Stylesheet uses .sass indented syntax (deprecated in favor of .scss)
Three jQuery plugins loaded (flexslider, colorbox, owl.carousel) for a single page
Google Fonts link has no integrity or crossorigin attributes
